batting.name: GC Smith
batting.dismissal: st MS Dhoni b M Muralitharan

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b L Balaji

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c JDP Oram b SB Jakati

batting.name: AS Raut
batting.dismissal: st MS Dhoni b SB Jakati

batting.name: ML Hayden
batting.dismissal: st NV Ojha b SK Warne

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c LA Carseldine b A Singh

balls.text: low full toss on the off, bunts it wide of cover for a single
important boundary, full toss on the pads, a terrible delivery anytime in the innings, worse when it's bowled in the last over, clips it away wide of short fine
full toss, no-ball, over waist height, tried to pull it over midwicket, mistimed it
played in the same direction again, low full toss on middle, pushed wide of the Hayden at extra cover where he dives to his left and saves a couple of runs
nicely done, good length on the off, makes room and clatters that wide of extra cover for a welcome four
good length on the off, makes room and clubs it down to long-off
full on middle and leg, driven back wide of Morkel who attempts to field that lethargically, misses and concedes a single
length ball on middle, made room and dug it out back to the bowler
nicely done, slower one bowled short on middle, made room and cut it past the keeper for a single to third man
on middle and leg, turned away off the front foot to deep midwicket
good length outside off, makes room and tries to slap it over the bowler's head, does so but off a mistimed shot, lands well short of the converging long-on and long-off
full toss outside leg, will be cursing himself for not getting that fine, salvages a leg bye
slower one bowled fullish on leg stump, tries to work it away but is struck on the pads
slog-swept this one wide of long-on who palms it back inside the ropes and they manage a couple
flighted on middle, and he made sure he didn't waste the chance, charged out and lofted it just wide of long-off, crashed into the ropes and he gets six
drifting into the right hander, defended to cover, nice going Jakati
tossed up on middle and leg, pushed wide of midwicket for a single

stumped, drew him out of the crease with the flight, spun away as he tried to smack that inside-out over cover, missed and Dhoni had no difficulty clipping the bails, the batsman didn't even bother making it back
tossed up on the off, swung across the line wide of long-on for a single
tries to work it away into the leg side, is struck on the pads but outside the line
compensates for his lapse off the previous ball, slog-sweeping that into the crowd behind deep midwicket, nice clean strike

run out, Balaji, you beauty, dropped it short of him at cover and called for a single, Carseldine at the non-striker's end had backed up too far by the time Raut sent him back, Balaji waited, took aim and threw down the stumps to find him miles short
quicker one bowled flat on leg stump, helped on its way to deep square leg
spun in from the off stump, pushed down to long-on from the crease
quicker one bowled short on middle, pushed wide of mid-on for a quick single
struck firmly down the ground to long-off

sucked him in, flighted it on the off, landed full, went for the slog-sweep well in front of square, the intended area was long-on and he got the direction right but way more elevation than he would have wanted, Oram judged it well and for a moment it seemed he would go over the boundary but retained his balance to take it inches inside the ropes
went for it, how did that miss, arm ball on middle and he tried to swing it over the fence behind deep midwicket, got an inside edge onto the pads and it rolled down to short third
short of a length outside off, spun away, dabbed straight to point, the pressure builds
slower through the air, landed on a good length on leg stump and spun towards middle, pushed back to the bowler
full toss the off, comes down the track and bunts it to long-off, the 100 up for Rajasthan

was early into the pull once again, hit high on the pads and scrambled for a single, Dhoni kicked the ball onto the stumps at the striker's end, remember he was a footballer once, a goalkeeper rather, but Yusuf was well in
low full toss on the off, driven past the bowler just to the right of extra cover for a quick single
short of a good length on the off, dropped short of point for a quick single
angling into the pads, waited for it and glanced it wide of short fine, just managed to get it past him and earned a boundary
slower one bowled short outside off, an offcutter, went for the pull but was way too early into the shot, missed
slower one bowled full outside off, landed full, he picked it well, made room to slice it to Raina at point, was dying on him but he dived forward to cup that inches from the ground, well done

that was coming, one of the biggest sixes of this year's IPL, tossed up, he was tempted, danced down the track and smashed it over long-on for a massive six, just the over they needed, 106 metres that monstrous hit
flatter on the off, went for the sweep, hit high on the pads and lobbed in front of Dhoni
pushed off the front foot wide of midwicket for a single
came of the middle, similar delivery, only slightly flatter, gets across and clubs it between deep midwicket and deep square leg for four more
finally, gave it some air, got across the line, to the pitch and slog-swept it powerfully over deep midwicket for a pressure-relieving six
shortish on the off, spinning in, jabbed to cover
and again, but missed it altogether this time, was fortunate this didn't spin in, just missed the off stump as he went for the sweep
went for the sweep, tried to play it square, mistimed it to midwicket
the doosra, beat him there, reached forward to defend, played inside the line and missed
on middle and off, came down the track and tried to work it away on the leg side, brushes the pads and goes to leg slip

stumped, didn't even appeal, Smith walked, spun away just as he tried to connect a slog-sweep, missed, and Dhoni dislodged the bails pretty quickly, Smith was outside the crease well after the stumps were disturbed
shortish on the off, eased wide of point for a quick single
stopped on him, went through with the shot chipping it wide of cover for a single
back of a length on middle, pushed straight to midwicket
beaten as the ball spun away, left his crease for a brief moment before dragging it back just in time as Dhoni clipped the bails
well played, slightly short on middle, makes room, uses the bounce well and cuts it away hard behind point, beats deep point and they get four more
angling into leg stump, tries to play ti away on the leg side, is hit on the pads
flighted on the off, converts it into a full toss and drives it down to long-on
almost lobbed it back to the bowler, bowled flat on the off from round the wicket, tried to close the face, got a leading edge just short of Murali
just a fraction short outside off, came from round the wicket, waited for it to spin away from him and dispatched it past point to the boundary
quicker one bowled short outside off, spun away, cut away straight to point
short of a length outside off, bunts it down to deep cover, there's an overthrow as Murali misses a return and they take one more
tossed up on middle, gets forward and sweeps it down to deep square leg
gets it to land on a good length outside off, spins away to beat the outside edge as Smith fishes for it
tossed up outside off, defended with bat close to pad, drops it short of cover for a single
paddled away behind square for a single this time
dropped, flighted on middle, tried to sweep it fine, got the top-edge and Tyagi at short fine was late to react, dived forward and spilt it
on middle and off, bunted into the leg side for a single
short of a length on the off, pushed off the back foot wide of midwicket for a single
tossed up on middle and leg, defended to midwicket
reaches forward, tossed up on middle and off, gets across the line and works it wide of midwicket for a single

swung across the line and was trapped in front, came round the wicket, was the overspinner, landed fullish on middle and leg, tried to sweep it square, was rapped on the pads and Dharmasena had no doubt
waited for it to spin away from him, landed on middle, punched off the back foot to long-on, the pair has added 50 now
targeting middle and leg, bunts it wide of midwicket for a single
spun away from Balaji at deep square leg, got to the pitch and swept it away wide of him but he ran over it, went off the middle, about time he got some runs
tossed up on middle, closes the face and pushes it towards square leg for a single
zipped away, got some good bounce as well, landed on middle and missed the outside edge as he tried to turn it wide of square leg
flatter on the off, slog-swept to deep midwicket for a single
short of a good length on the off, punched to midwicket off the back foot
flighted, drew him out of his crease, Smith got to the pitch and tried to heave it over midwicket, mistimes it to deep square leg
short again, on the off and spun away, pulled away towards deep square leg
angling down leg, given a wide, tried to sweep it down fine, gets an extra ball
long hop on the off, pulled away to deep midwicket, poor ball first up
quicker one, held its line, appeared to pitch on middle and leg and rapped him on the pads as he tried to work that behind square, came round the wicket, height may have been a factor there
flat, pitched outside leg and spun in towards middle and off, Smith missed the sweep and was struck on the pads, big appeal but we know that can't be given
flatter on middle, defended wide of midwicket with a lunge
almost another four, similar ball, identical shot, swept powerfully all along the ground but Oram does well diving to his right from deep midwicket to save a couple of runs
tossed up on the off, driven back to the bowler from the crease
dispatched for four first ball, gave it some air, full on the off, gets forward, bends low and sweeps it firmly wide of deep midwicket
angling into middle from wide of the crease, defended to cover
Balaji does well at cover, full and wide, reached forward and drove it forcefully but the new Jonty flings himself to his right to save a couple
struck fiercely, short and wide, makes room and cuts it powerfully over point for a flat six, he's been a little lucky this innings but is slowly but surely finding his touch
comes down the track again, tries to whip that past square leg, is hit high on the pads
had been restrained for so long, charged down and tried to dismiss that over deep square leg, got the top edge and was fortunate that landed well behind Dhoni
back of a length on the off, defended from the crease to midwicket
good length on the off, worked away wide of midwicket for a single
overpitched, picks it early, launches into the drive but straight to cover where the fielder dives and keeps them to a single
good length on the off, defended to short cover off the front foot
angling into the right hander,nipped back in from outside off and struck him on the thighs as he went through with an attempted strike past the bowler
on middle and leg, the slower one this time, turned wide of midwicket for quick single
fullish on the off, swinging in to middle, gets forward to defend

connects it well this time, seized the length early, short outside off, got back and pulled it away over midwicket, cleared him comfortably, risky but that's how he plays, looks good when he pulls it off and ugly when he gets out
short of a good length on the off, dabbed to point from the crease
banged in short on the off, guided down wide of the keeper to third man for a couple
short outside off, goes for the pull, gets a top edge short of third man, ugly swipe, not unlike some of the shots he's got out to earlier in the tournament, almost cost him his wicket again
cramping him there, bang on target, leaps off the pitch, defended short of the bowler
back of a length on the off, chopped down to third man for a single
fullish on middle and leg, driven straight to midwicket again, he's timing them well but is struggling to pierce the gap
banged in short on middle, goes for the hook, misses
full on middle, worked away to midwicket from the crease, nice flick but straight to the fielder
good length on the off stump, dropped short of cover for a quick single
length ball outside off, tries to ease it through the covers again, gets an inside edge to midwicket
full outside off, gets to the pitch and creams it through the covers, went off the middle, sweet sound of bat hitting ball
short of a good length outside off, dropped short of point and scampers through for a quick single
probing line just outside off stump, defended to the bowler
back of a length, much closer to the off stump, moves back and guides it down to third man
short of a good length outside off, plays a little away from his body, tries to cut, misses
short of a good length on middle, worked away to fine leg from the crease
straying on the pads, misses out as he is struck on the pads while trying to glance it fine
good length on middle and leg, pushed off the front foot to mid-on
poor ball, on leg stump, a full toss swung away wide of fine leg for a boundary, nice over uptil then and he spoilt it with that rubbish
fullish on middle, pushed off the front foot to mid-on

timber, bowled at around 137 kmph, bowled on a length on middle and off, moved away a touch, Ojha had made room, too much in hindsight and failed to make contact as it zipped through to crash into offstump.
good length on the off, gets forward and drives it to cover off the front foot

an inswinging yorker first up, at 134.7 kmph, Graeme Smith just managed to dig it out, got a thick inside edge to fine leg, caught his South African team-mate by surprise there, nicely handled in the end
all over, bowled on a good length on middle, makes room and chips it over cover to knock off the remaining runs
tickled off the front foot behind square for a single
his best shot of the innings, slower one bowled full on middle, drives it past the bowler, presenting the full face to beat mid-on and long-off
slower one bowled on a length outside off, made room to cart that over cover, missed as it cut away
length ball on middle, gets under it and smashes it over mid-on for a boundary, gets to his fifty, under pressure to perform and has done wonderfully well here
there's no long-on so a safe shot, slower one bowled outside off, struck it over mid-on, cleared him comfortably, two more
fell just short of deep midwicket, bowled on a good length on middle and off, went for a mighty swing, didn't get hold of it much to his benefit as it landed just short of Yusuf Pathan
slower one cutting into the right hander, defended on the pitch, calls for a single but is sent back
pitched on a good length outside off, defended back to the bowler

stumped down the leg side, saw him come down and fired it outside leg, it spun down further as Hayden missed, Ojha took it well diving to his right and then held his balance to take down the stumps, Hayden was miles out
flighted outside leg stump, driven down the ground to long-on
a touch fuller, pushed back to the bowler, targeting middle and leg
picked it beautifully, he's almost caught up with Hayden here, short on middle, waited for it to spin away, rocked back and pulled it away wide of mid-on for a boundary
short of a length outside off and spun in, pulled away to deep square leg
tossed up on leg stump, comes down and chips it between deep midwicket and deep square leg for a couple more

it works this time, short of a length, attempted bouncer, moved away and cut that past Raut, connected well this time, and who would have thought that it will be Badri, not Hayden, who would cut loose
banged in short outside off, tried to upper cut that past the keeper, missed
a decisive over this, full toss on leg stump, misdirected, was trying for the yorker, just a slight shuffle and whip over short fine, rached away for four
full and wide, poor ball that, moved away and steered it wide of point, a massive gap between deep point and third man and he finds it perfectly
picked it nicely, full outside off, moved across and clipped it over square leg for two more, picking up the pace now
Badri pulls off a superb six, banged in short just outside leg, moved across and paddle it over the ropes at fine leg, the pressure eases a touch, excellent improvisation
fullish on middle and leg, bunted just wide of long-on, there's pressure on the fielder and they charge back for the second
tossed up on middle and leg, charges down the track and drives it firmly between long-on and deep midwicket, a crucial boundary that
drilled down the ground to long-off, struck powerfully, a fumble in the deep and they come back for the second
brushes the pads as he goes for another big one over the leg side, gets a legbye this time
good length on leg, tries to slog-sweep that over deep midwicket, misses it completely and is struck on the pads
helped on its way to fine leg, short outside leg
bunts it down the ground to long-on for a single
low full toss on the off, driven straight to mid-off
moved away to clear cover, was not to the pitch, a shot more out of desperation than anything else, gets an inside edge and that rolls wide of fine leg for a boundary
bowled short on middle and leg, pulled away and lands just short of deep midwicket
low full toss on leg, driven down the ground to long-on
bowled on a length on middle and off, dug out to the bowler, excellent over
pitched outside leg, bowled full on leg stump, tried to sweep it over square leg, was hit on the pads
short of a length outside off, cut away towards deep point for a single
on middle and leg, tried to turn it away, hit high on the pads, scampers through for a run
stepped out to slap him down the ground, played it straight back
tries to replicate that dab wide of short third again but fails to pick the slower one, is a little too early into the shot, misses
driving length outside off and he was sucked in, went for a forceful shot through cover but it moved away a hint to beat the outside edge
slower one bowled short on the leg stump, pulled away to deep square leg
back of a length on the off, opens the face to guide it to third man
slower one bowled short outside off, picked the gap well, waited for it and helped it on its way wide of short third for a boundary
slower one on the leg stump, moved across to paddle it fine, mistimed it wide of midwicket, went off the toe of the bat
flipper, on middle, skid off the pitch, played it to midwicket
tossed up, drilled down to ground to long-off
saw him come down and hurled it short and wide, cut away straight to point
flighted on middle, swept down to deep square leg
on middle and off, paddled down to short fine for a quick single
short outside off, should have been dispatched, it held its line, it was a flipper, missed out on the pull, played for the spin
angling it into the pads, clipped away towards deep square leg
landed full on middle, bunts it down to long-on
wide down the leg side, spun down leg and was given
tossed up on middle and leg, driven down to long-on
good length on the off, pushes it to mid-off with a straight bat
tossed up on middle, driven down the ground to long-on
sort on middle, pushed off the front foot to long-on for a single
short of a good length on middle, spun in, adjusted well and pushed that wide of cover
flighted, walks down the pitch towards his country-mate and smashes it over his head for a contemptuous six
ooh, tossed up on middle and leg, and spun down as he tried to sweep, an appeal for a caught behind, probably thought he gloved it but was too close to call, the replays were inconclusive
shaped himself for a cut but spun back in sharply, played it to midwicket
cheeky, flighted outside off, reverse-slapped it behind point for a boundary, an element of disdain in that shot there
spun in from wide outside off, zipped back in but was still wide enough for the umpire to spread his arms
round the wicket to Haydos, bowled on a length outside off, slices it towards point where a misfield fetches them three runs
tossed up on the off, swept down to deep square leg for a single
nicely done, waited for it to spin into him and dabbed it delicately wide of short third for a pressure-relieving boundary
quicker, bowled at 100.2 kmph from outside off and spun in to catch him on his gloves
zipped back in, quicker through the air, it's spinning big here, defended onto the pitch
pushed away wide of square leg for a single, Badri calls for a second but is sent back
zipped away prodigiously, left it alone this time too, a maiden but for those three wides
flighted outside off, spun away, left alone to the keeper this time
straying in line, pitched outside leg and didn't spin as much as he wanted it to, beat the keeper for three wides
beaten again, spun away sharply as he prodded at it, pretended to withdraw but he knew he was owned there
bowled on a good length on middle and off, guided to short third
flighted on middle, driven back to the bowler
tossed up outside off, drew him forward and spun away just as he reached for it
massive blow, short of a good length outside off, went for a mighty pull, was a little early into the shot, got the top-edge and Carseldine pouched it easily at point
swings across the line and falls safe behind midwicket, slower one bowled on a good length outside off, failed to pick the pace but got enough on it to clear the in-field
back of a length on middle, defended off the back foot to cover
slower one bowled on a good length outside off, cut away to meet Raina's prod
back of a length on the off, got back and punched it firmly wide of cover for a boundary
imperious, length ball outside off, got under it nicely and lofted it with a bent knee over long-on for a massive six
good length on middle and off, pushed to mid-off
back of a length on leg stump, pushed uppishly wide of midwicket for a quick single
in the channel outside off, pushing him back, defended to cover, tidy stuff this
pushed it full this time, good length on middle, pushed back to the bowler
back of a length on middle, gets behind it nicely and drops it to mid-off
straying down the leg side, tries to clip it fine, misses, a wide
short of a good length on middle and off, defended solidly to cover
short of a good length on the off, pushed to mid-off
quicker one bowled on a good length on the off and moving away, left alone
on middle and off, pushed straight to cover
finds the gap this time, was frustrated for a bit but received a gift ball there, short and wide, rocked back and punched it wide of a diving cover to the boundary
short of a length on middle and spinning away, mistimes a sweep, drops it on the pitch
short of a length on middle, defended back to the bowler
that looked out, full on middle, Vijay moved across to flick it towards square leg, hit the pads before the bat and was plumb
slower one again, waited for it and punched it wide of mid-off for a single
slower one bowled short on the off stump and cut away, Hayden didn't spot it, came down the track to pull it away, missed
pulled it back and bowled it slow, 113.7 kmph, pulled away to fine leg, too early into the shot but adjusted well
slapped it over the bowler's head, his patience was being tested there, short of a length outside off and he clatters it over long-on, he's away
beaten this time, much closer to the off, bowled from wide of the crease, angling in and getting it to cut away, Vijay slashed at it, missed
short and wide, chases it, misses as it moves away, given a wide
in the channel outside off, opens the face to guide it past point for a single
short of a good length, punched off the back foot to extra cover
bowled on a good length outside off, went for a mighty pull but it zipped through him, kept a little low
bowled on a good length on middle, pushed back past the bowler past  a diving Singh to mid-on
angling into middle, dropped into the off side
back of a length on the off, pushed back to the bowler
stopped on him and spun away, reached for it and dragged it past the bowler, Smith at mid-on fumbled it to allow it roll through his legs and concede a couple of runs
unfortunate for Yusuf, landed on a good length on middle and spun away sharply, took the outside edge as he pushed at it off the back foot, beat short third to the boundary
on middle and leg, gets back and turns it away behind square for a single
short of a length on middle, whipped off the back foot wide of midwicket for a single
bowled flat on middle and leg, turned away wide of midwicket for a single
